name: How can I prevent mold from returning after cleanup?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent mold from returning after cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing mold recurrence after cleanup involves controlling moisture and improving ventilation. Immediately address any leaks or water intrusions, such as leaky pipes or roof issues. Ensure proper ventilation in bathrooms, kitchens, and basements, using exhaust fans and dehumidifiers to keep indoor humidity levels below 60%. Regularly clean and dry areas prone to moisture, and consider mold-resistant paints or materials in high-risk areas. Maintaining a dry environment is key to keeping mold away.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent mold by fixing leaks, controlling humidity with ventilation and dehumidifiers, and regularly cleaning moisture-prone areas.
